gloss: to fall asleep, to go to sleep

definitions.gloss: to fall asleep, to go to sleep
definitions.explanation: To transition from being awake to being asleep.

definitions.gloss: to take root, to become established
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe a habit, custom, or idea becoming firmly established.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がやっと{寝付|ねつ}いた。
なかなか{寝付|ねつ}けなくて{困|こま}った。
examples.english: I had trouble falling asleep and it was a problem.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}くて{寝付|ねつ}きが{悪|わる}い{日|ひ}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The hot weather has made it hard to fall asleep for days.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}の{試験|しけん}のことが{気|き}になって、{夜|よる}なかなか{寝付|ねつ}けなかった。
examples.english: I was worried about tomorrow's exam and couldn't fall asleep at night.

examples.japanese: この{習慣|しゅうかん}が{寝付|ねつ}いた。
その{考|かんが}え{方|かた}は{社会|しゃかい}に{寝付|ねつ}いている。
examples.english: That way of thinking has taken root in society.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{制度|せいど}がなかなか{寝付|ねつ}かない。
examples.english: The new system isn't becoming established easily.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{努力|どりょく}のおかげで、リサイクルの{意識|いしき}が{地域|ちいき}に{寝付|ねつ}いてきた。
examples.english: Thanks to years of effort, recycling awareness has taken root in the community.

examples.japanese: この{地方|ちほう}では{昔|むかし}からの{祭|まつ}りの{伝統|でんとう}がしっかりと{寝付|ねつ}いていて、{毎年|まいとし}{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{参加|さんか}する。
examples.english: In this region, the tradition of the old festival is firmly established, and many people participate every year.

notes:
{寝付|ねつ}く is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to fall asleep.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {寝|ね}る (to sleep) + {付|つ}く (to attach, to settle) → to settle into sleep

ASPECT (ている):
{寝付|ねつ}いている indicates a state of being asleep (having fallen asleep).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- なかなか{寝付|ねつ}けない (can't fall asleep easily)
- やっと{寝付|ねつ}いた (finally fell asleep)
- {寝付|ねつ}きがいい/{悪|わる}い (easy/hard to fall asleep)
- すぐに{寝付|ねつ}く (fall asleep quickly)

RELATED NOUN:
- {寝付|ねつ}き: the ability to fall asleep; {寝付|ねつ}きがいい = falls asleep easily

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {眠|ねむ}る: to sleep (more general)
- {寝|ね}る: to go to bed, to sleep
- {寝付|ねつ}く specifically refers to the act of falling asleep

[Register: Neutral]
